objects.prompt: Sci-fi heavy transport dropship, top-down 3/4 RTS view from above and slightly behind. Round-bodied military carrier vessel with prominent wings — fighter-bomber style transport. Body proportions are approximately 1.5× the Marine's silhouette in length. Body: rounded fuselage with curved hull and rounded nose at the front, narrowing toward the rear cargo ramp. NO sharp corners on the main hull. Visible mechanical detail: panel seam lines dividing the hull into clear plate sections, small mechanical greebles and sensor protrusions, exposed structural ribbing along the fuselage sides. Wings: TWO prominent swept-back wings extending 12-15 pixels laterally from the body, clearly visible from above. Each wing has visible mechanical detail — panel lines, leading-edge slats, structural ribbing. Two-tone hull palette: main body is dark gunmetal gray (#3a3d42, like the Marine reference), but panel sections along the wings, nose, and dorsal surface are a slightly lighter steel-gray (#5a6068). The contrast between the two grays creates visual hierarchy. Accent markings: bright orange (#ff6b1a) safety/military stripes painted across the wing tips, a band along the side of the fuselage, and a small marker chevron on the dorsal surface near the nose. The orange marking provides a striking visual focal point against the dark hull. Engines: TWO large engine nacelles, one mounted on the underside of each wing. Each engine has a glowing exhaust point emitting cyan light (#00d4ff) with a bright glow halo. Small cyan running lights along the hull edges add additional points of light. Cargo bay: a closed ramp at the rear of the body for unit deployment. Same rendered shading as Marine reference — 3-4 shade tones per surface. Heavy-duty military fighter-bomber transport aesthetic.
